video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Practice Media Availability 🎙️ | Tyrese Maxey | 10.15.26

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on the improved health of the 76ers roster
quotes.excerpt: We're all healthy. A lot of guys are pretty healthy. I think that's that's different.
quotes.quote: We're all healthy. A lot of guys are pretty healthy. I think that's that's different. And then preseason, last year, it was kind of hard to get Paul George in. He was going through a little bit of things. Joel Embiid was going through some stuff. So our first five has been pretty healthy and we've been out there pretty much every day and that helps.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey says the 76ers roster is healthy to start the season. Maxey noted that unlike last preseason, the core group including Joel Embiid and Paul George has been able to practice together consistently.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on the offensive impact of Paul George
quotes.excerpt: He can play with so many different groups, so many different lineups because of the way he shoots.
quotes.quote: I'm super excited about Paul George. The little bit that we've seen of him, just the way he shoots the ball, it's going to open up so many different things. He can play with so many different groups, so many different lineups because of the way he shoots the ball. I'm excited to get on the court with him.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey is excited about the offensive versatility Paul George brings to the 76ers. Maxey says the way George shoots the ball is going to open up so many different things for their lineups.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on how preparation reduces pressure for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Proper preparation prevents poor performance. So for us, we're trying to prepare the right way.
quotes.quote: If you prepare, that takes the pressure away. My dad used to tell me, proper preparation prevents poor performance. So for us, we're trying to prepare the right way so when we get out there to force the performance, it's time to execute what we got to execute.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey on the 76ers approach to the season: If you prepare, that takes the pressure away. Maxey says the team is focused on proper preparation to ensure they are ready to execute when it counts.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey defines sacrifice as building team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: Sacrifice doesn't always mean you got to give up something. Sacrifice could mean Joel Embiid working out with LeBron James.
quotes.quote: Sacrifice doesn't always mean you got to give up something. Sacrifice could mean Joel Embiid working out with LeBron James. They're working out together before practice, or me working out with Vince Carter, or Vince Carter working out with Paul George, or me working out with Jalen Brunson. That's sacrifice. You kind of change your routine a little bit to try to get some camaraderie. That's the sacrifice we're talking about. Then getting on your teammates, being able to, hey man, LeBron, you supposed to crack them down right there, or Vince Carter with the X out. That's sacrifice as well.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey is redefining sacrifice for the 76ers. He says it is not just about giving things up, but changing routines to build chemistry, like working out with teammates and holding each other accountable on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on the 76ers' defensive focus
quotes.excerpt: Defending, getting stops. We're getting stops and just the times that we played, we're getting stops.
quotes.quote: Defending, getting stops. We're getting stops and just the times that we played, we're getting stops where we can be pretty good. I think that's going to be our biggest thing. We're going to have to hang our hat on defense in. We're going to be a team defense and a team rebounding team, and I think that will really help us.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey says the 76ers are making defense their primary identity. Maxey emphasized that the team is committed to being a collective defensive and rebounding unit to find success this season.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on the importance of Joel Embiid's health
quotes.excerpt: And now for him to be healthy throughout the entirety, like I said, you can put in more packages.
quotes.quote: And now for him to be healthy throughout the entirety, like I said, you can put in more packages. It's been times where he hasn't been healthy, then we get into the game and now we're trying to learn on the flow. I've been here so I kind of know what he wants with the cuts and all that stuff, but like, if you haven't played with a big like Joel Embiid, which there's not many, it's very hard and very difficult to learn certain things, like when to cut, when to slide over, when to throw it in the post.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey says Joel Embiid being healthy is a game changer for the 76ers offense. Maxey explains that having Embiid available allows the team to install more complex packages rather than trying to learn on the fly.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on the 76ers' unselfish turnover rate
quotes.excerpt: But they're unselfish turnovers. Those turnovers you can live with.
quotes.quote: The biggest thing that I've seen is guys are unselfish. When we played Brooklyn, all of us played. We had a lot of turnovers. But they're unselfish turnovers. Those turnovers you can live with. They're not turnovers on guys trying to do too much. They're turnovers on guys trying to be unselfish and get their teammates involved and the chemistry with that will come and we can live with those type of turnovers right now.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey says he can live with the 76ers current turnover rate. Maxey noted that the turnovers are coming from players trying to be unselfish and get teammates involved rather than trying to do too much.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on Paul George's growth as a player
quotes.excerpt: Paul George has gotten better every single day. He grows as a player every single day.
quotes.quote: Paul George has gotten better every single day. He grows as a player every single day. His mind grows, his athleticism grows. He was dunking last year, but he wasn't dunking like this. You can tell he got a little bit stronger, a little bit more confident, and I'm excited to step on the court and compete with him.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey is impressed by Paul George's physical condition. Maxey says George has gotten stronger and more confident, noting that he looks even more athletic than he did last season.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on the team's chemistry and competitiveness
quotes.excerpt: I think the camaraderie, that's the biggest thing, how fast we clicked.
quotes.quote: I think the camaraderie, that's the biggest thing, how fast we clicked. Like we laugh a lot. Of course we're serious on the court, but like locker room we laugh a lot, dinner we laugh a lot, we talk to each other. And the second biggest thing is which I kind of already knew this, but we compete. We're very competitive and that's in every drill, anything.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey says the 76ers have clicked quickly off the court. Maxey highlighted the team's camaraderie and competitive nature in practice as the biggest positives heading into the season.
